header.origin: a corner of the court, which is 94 by 50 feet
header.record_ends: before the ball reaches the hoop

tracking_noise.note: measured across the set, not quoted by the vendor; mildly correlated frame to frame

source.tracking: SportVU optical tracking, 2015-16 NBA season, the last season with public tracking data, via github.com/linouk23/NBA-Player-Movements
source.play_by_play: shufinskiy/nba_data, joined on period and game clock
source.venue: the arena is the home team's; it is not stated separately

fields.t: time from the first frame of the record
fields.hoop_x: the target hoop, along the court
fields.hoop_y: the target hoop, across the court
fields.dist_ft: shot distance in FEET, measured from the tracking
fields.official_dist_ft: shot distance in FEET as recorded by the official scorer -- an independent estimate of the same quantity
fields.shooter: surname as it appears in the play-by-play
fields.shot_type: as recorded by the official scorer
fields.clock_s: seconds remaining in the period at the first frame
fields.id: shot id, stable across every file in this set

header.role: test set: medium records. Each arc holds more of the flight than the short set and still stops before the hoop.
